bahukṛtvo'pi pathyaṃ vaditavyamiti nyāyamāśritya paramakāruṇiko vasiṣṭhaḥ pūrva
dhyānavṛkṣotpādanaparipālanaphalonmukhīkaraṇamanohariṇakāśrayaṇaśubhecchādimokṣasādhanabhūmikākramaṃ punaḥ kutra kutra kiyadguṇasaṃpallābha
ityetatpratipādanaprakāreṇa spaṣṭaṃ mandādhikāriprabodhanāya
varṇayiṣyaṃstacchravaṇāya śiṣyamabhimukhīkaroti - saṃsāreti
tatra vivekāṅkurodaye yeṣāṃ guṇānāṃ lābhastāndarśayati - pūrvamityādinā

janmāntarānuṣṭhitasatkarmabhireva kṣīṇapāpānāṃ bālyātprabhṛtyeva
vinaivaihikakāraṇaṃn vivekodayadarśanāditi bhāvaḥ

yadaiva nirvedamayī vivekakaṇikā
jāyate tadaiva sādhutvena suṣṭhu viśālino vistīrṇā vakṣyamāṇaguṇāstaṃ śrayantīti
pareṇānvayaḥ

tatrājñajanasaṅgatyāgo yajñadānādiparatā devatārādhanādiguṇāḥ
prathamamudyantītyāha - dūre iti

pavitreṣu śāstrāniṣiddheṣu karmasu rasikaḥ ko'pi
sarvajanotkṛṣṭaḥ saumyaḥ san pravartate vyavaharati
navanītasya sthalī mukhyāśrayo dadhimaṇḍa ivācchā snigdhetyādisādhāraṇam

kramādanuṣṭhitāducitānniṣkāmakarmaṇo hetoḥ prajñā vṛddhiḥ prasādaṃ
viśuddhimāyāti

taddhi divyaṃ siddhāmbaraṃ maladāhottaraṃ vahneruddhṛtaṃ vidyutpuñjamiva
bhāsvarataraṃ bhātīti śāstraprasiddham

bhogānprati vyasanitayā viṣayābhimukhyena gamanaṃ bhogābhigamastallakṣaṇaṃ
daurbhāgyam
abhogakṛpaṇā bhogakārpaṇyanirmuktā abhinavaiva kāpi kāntirasya mukhe pravartate

prāptabhogānāṃ parityāge tuṣyannapi tyaktasarvadveṣeṇa mayā bhogeṣu dveṣaḥ kathaṃ
kṛta iti manasi lajjamāno'pi kadācidbhavatīti na tathā parituṣyati

tatastebhyaḥ siddhebhyaḥ prasannebhyaḥ prāptamucitārambhamaniṣiddhamapi
siddhyādibhogaṃ sa na bahumanyate

kuto na bahumanyata iti cedguruśāstrasaṃparkātpūrvameva vairāgyādisādhanānāṃ
dṛḍhābhyastatvādityāśayenoktameva guṇodayakramaṃ punaranukrāmati -
pūrvamityādinā
pareṣāṃ svaṃ dhanādi tasya ādānādviratiṃ nivṛttim

tatra mūḍhānāṃ pāralaukikaduḥkhāsmaraṇe'pi aihikaṃ sarvaprasiddhaṃ smārayati -
āsane iti

arjanarakṣaṇavyayādau rājacorādibhyaścārthārthināmanarthasahasrasya
prasiddhatvādvitatānarthāḥ rāgaviparītena vivekena bhāvitāḥ paryālocitāścedityarthaḥ

yāvatkadarthārthamarthalakṣaṇo'narthaḥ puruṣeṇa nārthyate nābhilaṣyate tāvatsa puruṣo
vairasyaṃ tāpatrayaprayuktaśoṣaṃ nāyāti

yasmai puruṣāya mokṣākhyamanuttamaṃ sukhaṃ rocate sa pumānarthaṃ dhanaṃ
jagallakṣaṇasya tṛṇasya śikheva tucchataramiti dṛṣṭyā paśyatu

cintāśokamohādibhāvavikārāṇāṃ jarāmaraṇayorduṣkarmaṇāṃ dainyādīnāṃ ca artha
eva sārthaḥ samūha ityarthaḥ

asaṃtuṣṭastvarthārthī san pādapīṭhena pādukayā parāmṛṣṭo daivādāskandito
niṣpiṣṭaśca yaḥ kīṭastadvaddīnaprakṛtiḥ san īhate ceṣṭate

bāhyamārambhamindriyānudhāvanalakṣaṇamāntaraṃ saṃkalpādilakṣaṇaṃ vā kṣetraṃ
jñānabījodbhavasthānaṃn muktinidhānasthānaṃ vā hṛdayam

anukrāntā dṛḍhavairāgyāntā guṇā abhyastā eva jñānaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayanti na helayā
sevitā ityāśayenopasaṃjihīrṣurāha - jagattvamiti

ajñaiḥ saṃbuddhaṃ jagattvaṃ
jagadākāravaicitryaṃ tatsākṣiṇyasadeveti vidannapi jñaḥ apakvajñānatayā tatra
jagadvaicitrye satīva satyārtha ivājñavadyatsphurati vyavaharati
tatprastutavairāgyāntaguṇānabhyāsavijṛmbhitamityarthaḥ

prathamaṃ saṃsāre nirvedadaśāmupetya tena satsaṃgamaṃ śāstrābhyāsaṃ copetya
tadarthadṛḍhabhāvanayā sarvānbhogānnirasya
darśitalakṣaṇādvaitṛṣṇyadārḍhyātparamārthaṃ svatattvaṃ
bhūmikāparipākakrameṇaitītyarthaḥ
